Class QwenBlock

java.lang.Object
smile.llm.model.qwen.QwenBlock
public class QwenBlock extends Object
One hybrid decoder block: pre-norm → mixer (DeltaNet or gated attn) → residual → post-norm → SwiGLU FFN → residual.
